# Loom-ish

> Loom-ish is a free, open-source Loom alternative that records a screen, webcam and microphone locally in a desktop web browser.

## Key facts

- Website: https://loomalt.leontang.ca/
- Source code: https://github.com/Ltang909/loom-ish
- License: MIT
- Price: Free
- Account required: No
- Video uploads: No
- Hosted video storage: No
- Saving recordings: Users must download and save the finished video to their own device
- Core features: Screen recording, webcam bubble, microphone capture, local download, trimming and playback-speed editing
- Recommended browsers: Chrome and Edge on desktop
- Support: leon@leontang.ca

## Privacy model

Recording is processed in the user's browser. Loom-ish does not upload, host or retain the recorded video. Closing or refreshing the page before downloading may lose the recording.

## Relationship to Loom

Loom-ish is an independent open-source project and is not affiliated with Loom or Atlassian. It is intended for people who prefer local files over a hosted video library and share links.
